# `oaap app standby-after`

let an unused instance go to sleep by itself after N minutes, or 'off' (RFC-0059 stage 3).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app standby-after name minutes
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | -- |
| `minutes` | at least 5, or 'off' |
